title: Moving the ends' pair carries KF3
claim: For a bracketing of the cycle and two marks (ends' pairs) one step apart, keeping every distinction's odd set and moving the mark is a coupling under which KF3's options correspond knot by knot (with a role change, the same pinned steps, the same new pairs and odd set), so the two chains have the same law on (odd sets, co-knotted pairs) until the first step that adds a state; hence every two presentations of a line with one meeting pattern grow their co-knotted pairs by one law, for every n, in that range.
standard_statement: A GF(2)-affine coupling of two Markov growths of betweenness split systems on a triangulated polygon with different marked sides.
